title: Boost your app’s speed and efficiency
description: Learn how to maximize your app’s performance and efficiency with Apple tools and technologies. In this online event, you'll explore how to identify performance opportunities and use Xcode and Instruments to gather and analyze key diagnostics. You’ll discover how to derive actionable insights from your data, including using coding agents to assist in building optimizations. You’ll also have the chance to take part in a Q&A with Apple experts. Agenda 10:00 a.m. – 12:00 p.m.: Technical sessions 12:00 – 1:30 p.m.: Lunch 1:30 – 2:30 p.m.: Q&A Note This is the online version of the event. To join us in Cupertino, sign up here.
